displayName: Guitar Coach API - AI provider error spike

documentation.content: More than 10 AI provider/agent request errors (OpenAI Responses API or the Agents SDK run) in a 15-minute window. Backed by ai_requests_total{outcome="error"} (src/ai-practice-planner/openai/openai-responses.service.ts, src/ai-routine-coach/agent/agent-runner.ts). Per this repo's architecture decision, an OpenAI outage does not affect /health/ready — this alert is the intended way to notice AI-specific degradation instead. VERIFY the metric.type filter below in Metrics Explorer before applying (see docs/monitoring/README.md).
